CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Project Overview

SIMP (Structural Intensity Modeling Package) is an R package providing a Bayesian modeling framework for bounded, compositional, and zero-heavy intensity data. It treats constraints as defining features of the data-generating process rather than transforming them away.

Build and Test Commands

# Run all tests
"C:\Program Files\R\R-4.5.2\bin\Rscript.exe" -e "devtools::test()"

# Run a single test file
"C:\Program Files\R\R-4.5.2\bin\Rscript.exe" -e "testthat::test_file('tests/testthat/test-simp_composition.R')"

# Check package (includes tests, examples, and documentation)
"C:\Program Files\R\R-4.5.2\bin\Rscript.exe" -e "devtools::check()"

# Load package for interactive development
"C:\Program Files\R\R-4.5.2\bin\Rscript.exe" -e "devtools::load_all()"

# Rebuild documentation

Architecture

Core Data Structures (S3 Classes)

  • simp_composition (R/simp_composition.R): Base class for compositional data where rows sum to 1 and values are in [0,1]. Stores component names, zero patterns, and observation counts as attributes.

  • simp_cover (R/simp_cover.R): Subclass of simp_composition for vegetation cover data with layer (stratum) support. Adds species names, layer assignments, and residual component tracking.

  • simp_prior / simp_priors (R/priors.R): Prior specification system with constructors for common distributions (normal, half-normal, half-Cauchy, gamma, beta, PC, LKJ). simp_priors() bundles priors for model parameters.

  • simp_parsed_formula (R/formula.R): Parsed model formula with extracted fixed effects, random effects (including nested/crossed/uncorrelated structures), and response information.

Key Modules

File Purpose
R/validate.R Diagnostic validation for compositional constraints, generates recommendations
R/zeros.R Zero identification (structural vs sampling), multiplicative/additive imputation
R/normalize.R Row normalization, residual component handling, log-ratio transforms (CLR/ALR/ILR)
R/collapse.R Component aggregation by mapping or layer, rare component collapsing
R/formula.R lme4-style formula parsing with random effect extraction
R/utils.R Internal validation helpers (not exported)

Class Hierarchy

simp_composition (matrix subclass)
    └── simp_cover (adds layer/species semantics)

Both classes preserve their type through subsetting operations via custom [ methods.

Design Patterns

  • Constructors validate by default but accept validate = FALSE for internal use
  • S3 methods provide print(), summary(), [, rbind(), as.matrix(), as.data.frame()
  • Error messages use cli package formatting throughout
  • Zero patterns tracked as matrix attributes for efficiency

Testing

Tests are organized by module in tests/testthat/. Test files mirror R source files (e.g., test-simp_composition.R tests R/simp_composition.R).

Vignettes

Theory vignettes (vignettes/theory-*.Rmd) cover the mathematical foundations. Focus is on compositional data constraints, dependence geometry, and model admissibility.
